compliance.summary: The About page presents GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering and software-delivery company, rather than the staffing and recruiting agency in the approved description. It also promotes an outdated bundled offer and includes unsupported company claims, client totals, and office contacts.

problems.title: Applied AI Engineering positioning
problems.issue: The page repeatedly describes GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner that delivers AI-native production, which contradicts the approved staffing and recruiting description.
problems.fix: Rewrite the page around GoGloby’s approved staffing and recruiting description and remove the software-delivery positioning.
